_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Data_Quests.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

1#2.chinese: 你收到本地一位法师的信件。他自称拥有关于旧社区活动中心的情报。
1#2.english: You received a letter from a local wizard. He claims to have information about the old community activity center.

10#2.chinese: 你发现了一块铜矿石。你不确定它有何用处，但是本地的铁匠应该有所见闻。
10#2.english: You found a piece of copper ore. You're not sure what use it has, but the local blacksmith should know about it.

10#3.chinese: 把铜矿石带到克林特的铁匠铺。
10#3.english: Bring the copper ore to Clint's blacksmith shop.

100#2.chinese: 罗宾弄丢了她最珍爱的斧子。她记得上次用它时，是在玛妮牧场的南边伐木。
100#2.english: Robin lost her most treasured axe. She remembers the last time she used it, she was chopping wood south of Marnie's ranch.

100#9.chinese: 嘿，你找到我的斧子了！这我就放心了……另一把斧子我用不惯，差点砍了自己的脚趾。非常感谢！
100#9.english: Hey, you found my axe! Now I can relax... I can't get used to using the other axe, and nearly chopped my own toe. Thanks so much!

101#2.chinese: 乔迪需要用一株新鲜的花椰菜做菜。她让你带给她一株。
101#2.english: Jodi needs a fresh cauliflower to cook with. She asks you to bring her one.

101#9.chinese: 哦，看起来很美味！谢谢你，我正需要这个。用它来做黄咖喱简直完美。
101#9.english: Oh, it looks delicious! Thank you, I needed exactly this. Using it to make yellow curry is simply perfect.

102#2.chinese: 镇长刘易斯找不到他的紫色“短裤”了。他托你悄悄地去找到后还给他……
102#2.english: Mayor Lewis can't find his purple "shorts". He asks you to quietly find them and give them back to him...

102#3.chinese: 找到并交还镇长刘易斯的紫色短裤。
102#3.english: Find and return Mayor Lewis's purple shorts.

102#9.chinese: 你找到了……在哪找到的？……噢！……呃……嘿。#$b#在那儿？我也不知道它怎么会跑到那里……*咳嗽*#$b#这件事天知地知你知我知。懂了吗？$u
102#9.english: You found them... where did you find them? ...Oh! ...Uh... heh. There? I don't know how they could have ended up there either... *cough* This matter: heaven knows, earth knows, you know, I know. Understood?

segments.pinyin: tiān zhī dì zhī nǐ zhī wǒ zhī
segments.gloss: just between us (heaven, earth, you and me know)

103#2.chinese: 潘姆想喝淡啤酒。普通的老啤酒不会有用的。如果你有啤酒花和酿造桶，就可以自己酿一杯了。
103#2.english: Pam wants to drink pale ale. Ordinary old beer won't do. If you have hops and a keg, you can brew a glass yourself.

103#3.english: Bring Pam a bottle of pale ale.

103#9.chinese: 快给我。*咕噜*……啊，就是这个口感。#$b#好喝又上瘾……隐约有柑橘和菠萝的清香，但香浓的酒味保证了味道的和谐。#$b#谢谢，孩子。这对我意义非凡。我就知道你靠得住。$h
103#9.english: Give it to me quick. *gulp*... Ah, that's the taste. Tasty and addictive... faint fresh aroma of citrus and pineapple, but the rich alcohol flavor keeps the taste harmonious. Thanks, kid. This means a lot to me. I knew you were reliable.

104#2.chinese: 德米特里厄斯需要一个新鲜的甜瓜做实验。
104#2.english: Demetrius needs a fresh melon for an experiment.

segments.pinyin: dé mǐ tè lǐ è sī

104#3.chinese: 带给德米特里厄斯一个甜瓜。

segments.pinyin: dé mǐ tè lǐ è sī

104#9.chinese: 太完美了！我正要用它做实验。忍不住想吃掉它啊！十分感谢。
104#9.english: So perfect! I was just about to use it for an experiment. Can't help wanting to eat it! Many thanks.

105#2.chinese: 乔治需要一个辣椒来给膝盖镇痛。
105#2.english: George needs a hot pepper to relieve pain in his knee.

105#9.chinese: 花了不少时间啊……嗯……不过质量和辣味都还不错。谢谢你啊。
105#9.english: Took quite a while... hmm... but the quality and spiciness are both not bad. Thanks.

106#2.chinese: 玛妮想给她的奶牛一份特殊奖励。她需要一捆苋菜。
106#2.english: Marnie wants to give her cows a special reward. She needs a bunch of amaranth.

106#3.english: Bring Marnie a bunch of amaranth.

106#9.chinese: 哦，是我要的苋菜！太感谢你了……我的牛一定会喜欢的！$h
106#9.english: Oh, it's the amaranth I wanted! Thank you so much... my cows will definitely love it!

107#2.chinese: 又到了黑莓生长的季节，但莱纳斯找不到他的篮子了！他请你帮他找找。他也不知道丢在了哪里。
107#2.english: It's blackberry growing season again, but Linus can't find his basket! He asks you to help him look for it. He doesn't know where he lost it either.

107#3.chinese: 找到莱纳斯的篮子并归还。
107#3.english: Find Linus's basket and return it.

107#9.chinese: 我的篮子！谢谢。这对我意义非凡。$h
107#9.english: My basket! Thanks. This means a lot to me.

108#2.chinese: 卡洛琳想为她的女儿刻一个南瓜头。她请你从农场带给她一个。
108#2.english: Caroline wants to carve a pumpkin head for her daughter. She asks you to bring her one from the farm.

108#9.chinese: 哦，是南瓜！长得也不错……阿比盖尔看到了一定会很开心。非常感谢，@！$h
108#9.english: Oh, it's a pumpkin! A nice-looking one too... Abigail will surely be happy when she sees it. Thanks so much, @!

109#2.chinese: 威利向你发起了捕鱿鱼的挑战。他告诉你可以在冬夜的海里找到它们。
109#2.english: Willy has challenged you to catch a squid. He tells you they can be found in the sea on winter nights.

109#9.chinese: 你还真打开了诶！不错。真不错。你还真行啊。#$b#冬天很适合拿出老钓竿钓鱼，不是吗？
109#9.english: You really opened it, huh! Not bad. Really not bad. You're really capable. Winter is great for taking out the old fishing rod and fishing, isn't it?

11#2.chinese: 如果你想要继续采矿，就需要建造一个熔炉。
11#2.english: If you want to keep mining, you need to build a furnace.

110#2.chinese: 克林特想让你送一个紫水晶给艾米丽。并告知她是他送的。
110#2.english: Clint wants you to deliver an amethyst to Emily. And tell her it was he who sent it.

110#3.chinese: 带给艾米丽一个紫水晶。

110#9.chinese: 哦，我最喜欢的晶石！你真是太好了！$h#$b#诶？你说是谁送的？$u#$b#哦，是从克林特那儿拿的？算了我也不管你从哪拿的，这真的很漂亮！谢谢你！*轻吻*。$h
110#9.english: Oh, my favorite crystal! You're so nice! Huh? Who did you say it's from? Oh, you got it from Clint's? Never mind, I don't care where you got it, it's really pretty! Thank you! *light kiss*.

111#2.chinese: 法师想让你下矿井找一个虚空精华给他。他要用来准备一种黑暗魔法。
111#2.english: The wizard wants you to go down the mines to find him a void essence. He will use it to prepare a kind of dark magic.

111#3.chinese: 带给法师一个虚空精华。
111#3.english: Bring the wizard a void essence.

111#9.chinese: 啊，你拿过来了。我很感激，这是 1,000 金的报酬。不过现在请你离开。
111#9.english: Ah, you brought it. I'm grateful, here is a 1,000 gold reward. But now please leave.

112#2.chinese: 克林特弄了把新锤子，他想用不同的金属试试手感。
112#2.english: Clint got a new hammer, and he wants to test how it feels on different metals.

112#9.chinese: 嘿，是我要的铁锭。看起来硬度……正好。#$b#非常感谢，@。我十分感激。
112#9.english: Hey, it's the iron bar I wanted. Looks like the hardness is... just right. Thanks a lot, @. I'm very grateful.

113#2.chinese: 罗宾来信向你要些硬木。
113#2.english: Robin wrote a letter asking you for some hardwood.

113#9.chinese: 哦，你带来了！我就知道可以拜托你，@。$h#$b#嗯……这木材正合适。就是我所需要的。谢谢！
113#9.english: Oh, you brought it! I knew I could count on you, @. Mm... this wood is just right. It's exactly what I need. Thanks!

114#2.chinese: 格斯要做烩鱼汤，但他需要一条青花鱼。
114#2.english: Gus wants to make braised fish soup, but he needs an albacore.

114#9.chinese: ……*吸气*……*吸气*……这个味道是？闻起来像是青花鱼啊！#$b#啊哈！你真拿来了！万分感谢！
114#9.english: ...*sniff*...*sniff*... what's this smell? Smells like albacore! Aha! You really brought it! Thanks ten thousand times!

115#2.chinese: 艾米丽想尝尝春天的味道。她想要一个新鲜的杏子。
115#2.english: Emily wants to taste the flavor of spring. She wants a fresh apricot.

115#9.chinese: 噢……你真做到了！谢谢了，看起来很好吃！$h
115#9.english: Oh... you really did it! Thanks, it looks delicious!

116#2.chinese: 艾芙琳想给她丈夫一个惊喜的礼物。
116#2.english: Evelyn wants to give her husband a surprise gift.

116#9.chinese: 哦，谢谢你，亲爱的。这韭菜看起来很可口。乔治会很高兴的。#$b#他早饭最喜欢吃韭菜炒鸡蛋了。
116#9.english: Oh, thank you, dear. This leek looks very tasty. George will be very happy. His favorite breakfast is leek stir-fried with eggs.

117#2.chinese: 皮埃尔会给带给他一盘生鱼片的人“上等报酬”。很明显，他十分想吃生鱼片啊。
117#2.english: Pierre will give a "top-class reward" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Clearly, he really wants to eat sashimi.

117#3.chinese: 带给皮埃尔一份生鱼片。
117#3.english: Bring Pierre a serving of sashimi.

117#9.chinese: 是时候了！我都快等不及了，太想要吃生鱼片了。*嚼*……嗯，太满足了。#$b#非常感谢，@。$h
117#9.english: It's about time! I could hardly wait, I wanted to eat sashimi so much. *chew*... mm, so satisfying. Thanks a lot, @.

118#2.chinese: 德米特里厄斯正在调查本地河豚的毒性。他希望你给他拿一条。
118#2.english: Demetrius is investigating the toxicity of local pufferfish. He hopes you'll bring him one.

segments.pinyin: dé mǐ tè lǐ è sī

118#3.chinese: 带给德米特里厄斯一条河豚。

segments.pinyin: dé mǐ tè lǐ è sī

118#9.chinese: 你来了。这个样品看起来很不错。我会马上把它冰起来。非常感谢，@！
118#9.english: You've come. This sample looks very good. I'll ice it right away. Thanks a lot, @!

119#2.chinese: 肯特想送一个杨桃给妻子当结婚纪念礼物。
119#2.english: Kent wants to give a starfruit to his wife as a wedding anniversary gift.

119#9.chinese: 嘿。嘘……别让乔迪看见。#$b#啊，看起来多汁美味。她会喜欢的。太感谢你了。$h
119#9.english: Hey. Shh... don't let Jodi see. Ah, it looks juicy and delicious. She'll like it. Thank you so much.

12#2.chinese: 你的熔炉既然打造好了，那么就可以开始打铁了。根据克林特的指示，置放 5 块铜矿石和 1 块煤炭进熔炉，应该就能生产出铜锭。
12#2.english: Now that your furnace is built, you can start smelting. According to Clint's instructions, putting 5 pieces of copper ore and 1 piece of coal into the furnace should produce a copper bar.

12#3.chinese: 使用熔炉打出一个铜锭。
12#3.english: Use the furnace to smelt one copper bar.

120#2.chinese: 镇长刘易斯想要一瓶松露油。他没说是用来做什么的。也许你不该多管闲事。
120#2.english: Mayor Lewis wants a bottle of truffle oil. He didn't say what it's for. Maybe you shouldn't meddle.

120#3.chinese: 带给镇长刘易斯一瓶松露油。
120#3.english: Bring Mayor Lewis a bottle of truffle oil.

120#9.chinese: 你把油拿来了？让我看看……#$b#品质很好嘛……十分顺滑。非常好。谢谢。
120#9.english: You brought the oil? Let me take a look... The quality is good... very smooth. Very good. Thanks.

121#2.chinese: 格斯发通知说他想要一只新鲜龙虾。
121#2.english: Gus put out a notice saying he wants a fresh lobster.

121#9.chinese: 好像闻到了龙虾的味道。哦，真是太好了。$h#$b#多保重，朋友。
121#9.english: I seem to smell lobster. Oh, that's really great. Take good care, friend.

122#2.chinese: 潘姆的电视遥控器没电了。她在沙发和电视控制面板之间来来回回地走太累了。
122#2.english: Pam's TV remote is out of power. She is too tired of walking back and forth between the sofa and the TV control panel.

122#9.chinese: 嘿，你真的弄到了电池组！谢谢你，孩子……你真是我的救星！$h
122#9.english: Hey, you really got the battery pack! Thank you, kid... you really are my savior!

123#2.chinese: 法师正在制作一把拥有惊人力量的法杖。没人知道这是干什么用的。他还差一个铱锭才能制作完成。
123#2.english: The Wizard is making a staff with astonishing power. Nobody knows what it's used for. He still lacks one iridium bar to finish making it.

123#3.english: Bring the Wizard one iridium bar.

123#9.chinese: 啊，珍贵的铱。你做的不错，@。我很感激。现在请你离开。
123#9.english: Ah, precious iridium. You did well, @. I'm very grateful. Now please leave.

124#2.chinese: 威利挑战你抓一条蛇齿单线鱼。
124#2.english: Willy challenges you to catch a lingcod.

124#3.chinese: 带给威利一条蛇齿单线鱼。

124#9.chinese: 嘿，这家伙真大啊！你真是有垂钓的天赋啊。$h
124#9.english: Hey, this guy is really big! You really have a talent for angling.

125#2.chinese: 格斯想作椰子奶酒，但还差一个主要素材。
125#2.english: Gus wants to make coconut milk liquor, but still lacks one main ingredient.

125#9.chinese: 椰子！这个冬天总算见到些好事了。$h#$b#这个用来做椰子奶酒再合适不过了。
125#9.english: Coconut! This winter I've finally seen something good. This couldn't be more suitable for making coconut milk liquor.

126#2.chinese: 你的妻子让你为她的秘密工程带 200 份纤维。
126#2.english: Your wife asks you to bring 200 portions of fiber for her secret project.

126#3.chinese: 给艾米丽带 200 份纤维。

126#9.chinese: 哦，这看起来很不错……而且来源还是有机的！非常感谢，@。$h#$b#现在，我要干活了，要花个几天时间才能完成……
126#9.english: Oh, this looks very good... and the source is organic too! Thanks so much, @. Now I have to get to work; it'll take a few days to finish...

127#2.chinese: 你的妻子正在镇上的广场组织慈善蛋糕竞走赛。她让你带一个巧克力蛋糕。
127#2.english: Your wife is organizing a charity cake race-walk in the town square. She asks you to bring a chocolate cake.

127#3.chinese: 在一个阳光明媚的早晨，带一个巧克力蛋糕到镇上去。
127#3.english: On a sunny, bright morning, bring a chocolate cake to town.

128#9.chinese: 那条项链！你在哪里找到的？$7#$b#啊，谢谢你把它还给我，@。希望我妈不要知道这事……$h
128#9.english: That necklace! Where did you find it? Ah, thank you for returning it to me, @. I hope my mom doesn't find out about this...

129#9.chinese: 这是什么？我的旧项链？$s#$b#真奇怪，我都没注意到弄丢了……嗯，谢谢你把它还回来，@。$h
129#9.english: What's this? My old necklace? How strange, I didn't even notice I'd lost it... Um, thank you for returning it, @.

13#2.chinese: 一位叫威利的人邀请你前往镇子南方的沙滩。他说有东西要给你。
13#2.english: A person called Willy invites you to go to the beach south of town. He says he has something to give you.

13#3.chinese: 在下午 5 点之前抵达镇子南方的沙滩。
13#3.english: Arrive at the beach south of town before 5 pm.

130#2.chinese: 住在姜岛上的一位老太太要你找到她丈夫的纪念品。她给了你一张冲到岸上的一位士兵的旧照片，希望它能够帮到你。
130#2.english: An old lady living on Ginger Island wants you to find her husband's keepsake. She gave you an old photo of a soldier that washed up onto the shore, hoping it can help you.

130#3.chinese: 寻找贝啼丈夫的纪念品。

131#2.chinese: 威利提出挑战，要你钓 3 条沙鱼。
131#2.english: Willy issued a challenge, wanting you to catch 3 sandfish.

132#2.chinese: 要想成为农场主，先要做好最基础的工作。每天都要记得喂鸡，可以放它们出来吃草，也可以把干草放到饲料槽里。等鸡成熟了，就可以收获蛋了！
132#2.english: If you want to become a farmer, first you must do the most basic work well. Every day remember to feed the chickens; you can let them out to eat grass, or put hay into the feed trough. When the chickens are mature, you can harvest eggs!

132#3.english: Harvest one egg laid by a chicken.

133#2.chinese: 罗宾是这里的木匠，她住在小镇的北边。你可以给她钱和原材料，让她建造新的农场建筑。等你建好筒仓，就可以用镰刀收割农场上的草，然后存起来喂养动物。
133#2.english: Robin is the carpenter here; she lives in the north of the town. You can give her money and raw materials to have her build new farm buildings. Once you've built a silo, you can cut the grass on the farm with a scythe, then store it to feed animals.

134#2.chinese: 农场南边的大树被刮倒了。如果有 100 块硬木，我可以把树桩修成有趣的东西……
134#2.english: The big tree south of the farm was blown down. If I had 100 pieces of hardwood, I could fix the stump into something interesting...

14#2.chinese: 镇子北方山脉处有一座旧矿场。里面也许有珍贵的矿物，但是马龙说那里可能有危险。
14#2.english: At the mountains north of town there is an old mine. Inside there may be precious minerals, but Marlon says it may be dangerous there.

15#2.chinese: 只要击杀 10 只史莱姆，你就有资格进入探险家公会。
15#2.english: As long as you kill 10 slimes, you'll be qualified to join the Adventurer's Guild.

15#3.chinese: 目前杀死了 10 个史莱姆中的 0 个。

16#2.chinese: 你成功消灭了 10 只史莱姆。你现在可以进入探险家公会了。
16#2.english: You successfully wiped out 10 slimes. You can now join the Adventurer's Guild.

17#2.chinese: 看来矿场的升降机依然能用。你能够通过它快速回到你之前发现过的任何升降机门口。现在可以更加深入矿场了。
17#2.english: It seems the mine's elevator still works. Through it you can quickly return to the door of any elevator you've discovered before. Now you can go deeper into the mine.

18#2.chinese: 当前依然未发现地底最深处。这到底有多深啊？
18#2.english: So far the deepest part underground has still not been found. Just how deep is this?

18#3.english: Reach the bottom of the mine.

19#2.chinese: 你在矿场地底发现了一把奇怪的钥匙。
19#2.english: At the bottom of the mine you found a strange key.

19#3.english: Look for the skull key's purpose.

2#2.chinese: 在一个隐秘的加密箱里，你发现了一张写着指示的纸条。署名者是齐先生的纸条。
2#2.english: In a hidden locked box, you found a note with instructions written on it. A note signed by Mr. Qi.

2#3.chinese: 在火车站台的箱子里留下一个彩虹贝壳。
2#3.english: Leave a rainbow shell in the box at the train platform.

20#2.chinese: 挑战要求你到达头骨山洞的第 25 层。成功的话能够获取丰厚的奖励。
20#2.english: The challenge asks you to reach floor 25 of the Skull Cavern. If you succeed you can get a generous reward.

20#3.chinese: 到达头骨山洞的第 25 层。
20#3.english: Reach floor 25 of the Skull Cavern.

21#2.chinese: 玛妮来到农场，要求你为她寻找一个山洞萝卜。她正在训练她的山羊说话，而山洞萝卜是它们的最爱。
21#2.english: Marnie came to the farm and asked you to look for a cave carrot for her. She is training her goats to talk, and cave carrots are their favorite.

21#3.chinese: 带一个山洞萝卜到玛妮的店铺。
21#3.english: Bring a cave carrot to Marnie's shop.

22#2.chinese: 乔迪来到农场邀请你在晚上 7 点去陪她吃晚餐。她的唯一的要求是你得带一条大嘴鲈鱼去给她制作砂锅鱼。
22#2.english: Jodi came to the farm to invite you to keep her company at dinner at 7 in the evening. Her only request is that you must bring a largemouth bass for her to make fish casserole.

22#3.chinese: 在晚上 7 点带着一条大嘴鲈鱼前往乔迪的家。
22#3.english: At 7 in the evening, go to Jodi's house carrying a largemouth bass.

23#2.chinese: 你发现了一个看起来很古老的东西。这会不会是远古的遗物呢？也许当地博物馆馆长冈瑟知道答案。
23#2.english: You found something that looks very ancient. Could this be a relic from ancient times? Maybe the local museum curator Gunther knows the answer.

23#3.english: Go to the museum to visit Gunther.

24#2.chinese: 冈瑟询问你是否能考虑把新发现的古物或矿石捐献给博物馆。他说他会回报以一些稀有的货物。
24#2.english: Gunther asks whether you could consider donating newly found artifacts or minerals to the museum. He says he'll repay you with some rare goods.

24#3.chinese: 向博物馆捐献一个古物或矿石。
24#3.english: Donate one artifact or mineral to the museum.

25#2.chinese: 送礼物是增进友谊的好办法。了解每个人的个人喜好，你快就会人见人爱了。
25#2.english: Giving gifts is a good way to strengthen friendship. Understand each person's personal preferences, and soon everyone will love you.

segments.gloss: loved by all who see you

26#2.chinese: 社区活动中心里面好像在发生一些奇怪的事情……
26#2.english: Inside the community center some strange things seem to be happening...

27#2.chinese: 有一个哥布林阻塞了去往女巫小屋的路。必须要想办法让他移开……或许我应该找出更多有关哥布林的信息。
27#2.english: A goblin is blocking the road to the witch's hut. I must think of a way to make him move... maybe I should find out more information about goblins.

27#3.chinese: 获得通往女巫小屋的入口。
27#3.english: Gain the entrance leading to the witch's hut.

28#2.chinese: 法师要我从他前妻家取回魔法墨水，…但是我需要一个暗黑护身符才能获得去往他前妻家的路。
28#2.english: The wizard wants me to fetch magic ink from his ex-wife's house... but I need a dark talisman to get the road to his ex-wife's house.

28#3.chinese: 进入下水道，询问科罗布斯有关暗黑护身符的事情。
28#3.english: Enter the sewer and ask Krobus about the dark talisman.

29#2.chinese: 你发现了一张模糊不清的纸条，让你把“沨唐酱”带到秘密森林。
29#2.english: You found a blurry, unclear note asking you to bring "mapel serup" to the secret forest.

29#3.chinese: 将“沨唐酱”带到秘密森林。
29#3.english: Bring "mapel serup" to the secret forest.

3#2.chinese: 你又发现一张齐先生的纸条。这次的要求更加非比寻常。
3#2.english: You found another note from Mr. Qi. This time the request is even more out of the ordinary.

3#3.chinese: 将 10 个甜菜放在刘易斯镇长的冰箱中。
3#3.english: Put 10 beets in Mayor Lewis's fridge.

30#2.chinese: 你找到一张纸条，上面写道：“有人在骷髅洞的第 100 层等你”
30#2.english: You found a note; on it is written: "Someone is waiting for you on floor 100 of the Skull Cave"

30#3.english: Reach floor 100 of the Skull Cave

31#2.chinese: 你在巴士站遇到了一个形迹可疑的身影。它看到你后，便向城镇逃去。那里会有线索指明它的下落吗？
31#2.english: At the bus stop you met a suspicious-looking figure. After it saw you, it fled toward the town. Will there be clues there pointing to its whereabouts?

4#2.chinese: 你发现又一张齐先生的纸条。这次的指示更加隐晦。
4#2.english: You found yet another note from Mr. Qi. This time the instructions are even more obscure.

4#3.chinese: 给沙之巨龙送上它的最后一餐。
4#3.english: Serve the sand's giant dragon its last meal.

5#2.chinese: 你发现又一张齐先生的纸条。这位齐先生的奇怪要求终于到达尾声了。
5#2.english: You found yet another note from Mr. Qi. This Mr. Qi's strange requests have finally reached their end.

5#3.chinese: 检查你房子旁边的木材堆。
5#3.english: Inspect the lumber pile beside your house.

6#2.chinese: 想要成为农夫，就要从基本开始学习。使用你的锄头锄松泥土，然后在泥土上使用种子袋以播种。每天浇水直到农作物成熟为止。
6#2.english: If you want to become a farmer, you must start learning from the basics. Use your hoe to loosen the soil, then use a seed packet on the soil to sow. Water every day until the crops are mature.

7#2.chinese: 本地的木匠罗宾就住在镇子北方。只要给她充足的原材料和金钱，她就会替你在你的农场里建造新的建筑。你需要让她帮你建造鸡舍和畜棚来饲养动物。
7#2.english: The local carpenter Robin lives just north of town. As long as you give her enough raw materials and money, she will build new buildings on your farm for you. You need to have her build you a coop and barn to raise animals.

8#2.chinese: 随着你的经验增长，你会发现新的配方可用于增加收入和改善生活。比如说稻草人可以防止乌鸦来偷吃你的珍贵农作物。
8#2.english: As your experience grows, you'll find new recipes that can be used to increase income and improve life. For example, a scarecrow can stop crows from coming to secretly eat your precious crops.

8#3.chinese: 达到耕种 1 级，打造一个稻草人。
8#3.english: Reach farming level 1 and make a scarecrow.

9#2.chinese: 跟镇子上的人自我介绍是很重要的。有些人会很好奇想认识新来的农夫。
9#2.english: Introducing yourself to the people in town is very important. Some people will be very curious and want to get to know the newly arrived farmer.
